issues.description: PersonResource.createPerson: In the solution, the REST handler method createPerson is declared with protected visibility, while other REST handler methods (for example NoteResource.createNote) are declared public. The template contains only a TODO for PersonResource (no implementation). The problem statement describes the POST /persons endpoint but does not specify visibility. This mismatch in access modifier between solution REST handlers is inconsistent and may confuse students about the expected visibility for Spring controller handler methods and the conventional practice of making such endpoint methods public.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the createPerson handler method public in the solution implementation (change 'protected ResponseEntity<Person> createPerson(...)' to 'public ResponseEntity<Person> createPerson(...)') so its visibility is consistent with other REST handler methods and to avoid confusion for students about expected access modifiers for controller endpoints.
